output_list.reason: The 'claimStakingReward' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a user's reward to the 'claimedReward' variable without ensuring it does not overflow, allowing users to steal funds.

The 'fundDAO' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds the user's reward and DAO funds to the 'claimedReward' and 'claimedDAOFund' variables respectively without ensuring it does not overflow, allowing users to steal funds.

The 'sellTokenForLRC' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds an amount to the 'claimedReward' and 'claimedDAOFund' variables without ensuring it does not overflow, allowing users to steal funds.
